goal: advance the cell-fidelity programme one milestone with a pre-registered, out-of-sample test
notes: Routed research/0 by weighted draw; security queue empty; IDEAS.md and website requests empty. pick_track drew cell-fidelity; no open PR claimed it. Ran 256 PyBaMM 26.10.1.1 runs (Mohtat2020, NCA_Kim2011; 64 Sobol seed-3 designs, SPMe and DFN, 100 cycles) in about 20 min at 3 workers, plus a 2-cycle probe of four candidate sets (Prada2013 and ORegan2022 fail on missing parameters). Primary verdicts: H33 refuted, H34 refuted, H35 mixed, H36 supported in letter only, H37 refuted. Cause: Mohtat2020's 6 mis-scored designs are all SPMe solver stops (IDA convergence failure, partial solution returned), not salt depletion. Post hoc: flagging early stops plus bottom-up verification reaches recall 1.00 on all five cells with fewer DFN calls than an 8-run calibration. Local checks: pytest research/cell-fidelity/tests 67 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links ok; research_live_links ok; check_post_frontmatter ok; post_similarity 0 pairs >= 0.25; cite_check: the two new DOIs could not be resolved (doi.org proxy 403), disclosed in the README.
